'''Loatha Sommover'''<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> was a [[Color|brown]]-skinned [[alien]] who spent time in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]]<ref name="TLJ" /> on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> Sommover wore a [[neural wave relaxer helmet]], a black coat and a ring that was both a [[comlink]] and a piece of decorative jewelry. The alien had a large [[Slug (creature)|slug]]-like body with four pairs of two-toed [[Limb|legs]] and one larger pair of three-fingered arms further up their body below a head with a [[mouth]], [[nose]] and two [[eye]]s.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Loatha-Sommover-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|King 12 by Ivan Manzella]]
Loatha Sommover first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref> Sommover was designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]], and their [[species]] was referred to by the production code "King 12."<ref name="TLJ Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], their species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref>
